On s'y assoit face à la mer pour se dema: You sit here facing the sea to wonder what everything is made of. Nobody blames the gods when it rains any more.
On y apprend à bien se conduire avec les: Here you learn to behave well with others and to let go of what you cannot hold. The gardeners take their tea here.
Un homme y demande à chacun ce qu'il cro: A man asks everyone here what they think they know. You leave annoyed, then come back.
On y fait cours en marchant, et on y cla: Lessons are given here while walking, and everything is classified: animals, causes, reasonings. The island library started here.
Du pain, de l'eau, des amis, et rien à c: Bread, water, friends, and nothing to fear. Next door, under the porch, others train themselves to bear anything.
Chaque soir, celui qui dirige la ville é: Every evening, whoever runs the town writes down what they did badly. The islanders prefer that to a self-satisfied leader.
On y traduit les livres venus de partout: Books that came from everywhere are translated here, and annotated in the margins. Without it, half the island's shelves would be empty.
Objection, réponse, objection : on y pou: Objection, reply, objection: reason is pushed here as far as it is willing to go. The simplest explanations often win.
On y relit les anciens, on y dessine des: The ancients are reread here, ideal cities are drawn, and people write what they think of princes. The editions come out of the printing works next door.
Une pièce chaude où l'on doute de tout j: A warm room where you doubt everything until you find one sure thing. The island's knowledge was rebuilt here from the foundations up.
On y rédige le grand dictionnaire de tou: The great dictionary of all the island's trades is written here, between two cups. Craftsmen come to correct the plates.
On y discute de liberté, de preuves et d: People discuss freedom, evidence and what we owe others. The bills are long, and so are the conversations.
Une maquette avec un levier, et personne: A model with a lever, and nobody agrees on what to do. The council practises here before hard decisions.
Gravée sur un mur : qui décide, qui juge: Carved on a wall: who decides, who judges, who checks. None of them is the same person.
Une pièce close qui répond à tout sans r: A closed room that answers everything without understanding anything, or maybe it does. Students debate it with the machines.
Avant d'entrer à la bibliothèque, chaque: Before entering the library, every discovery is redone here by someone else. Some do not come back.
